# Influence a Colleague Who Prefers a Different Approach

[← Amazon](../README.md) · [Every Amazon question](../../amazon.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/influence-a-colleague-who-prefers-a-different-approach)

---

Tell about a time you persuaded a colleague who initially favored an alternative method for achieving a mutual objective.

### Constraints & Assumptions
Draw from an actual event and clearly separate your personal contribution from the team's collective work. The source provides the interview prompt alone, not an example answer; any illustrative anecdotes in the solution are fictional.

### Clarifying Questions
What was each approach optimizing for? What specific concern drove your colleague's preference? In what ways did you exert influence without leaning on any formal authority?

### What a Strong Answer Covers
An even-handed depiction of the other person's stance, jointly agreed evaluation standards, some form of evidence or a small pilot, and the final decision together with how it affected your ongoing working relationship.

### Follow-up Questions
What did you modify in your own view after taking in the other perspective? How did you discern that the agreement was real rather than surface-level? What would your next move have been if your colleague had stayed unconvinced?

Overview:
Explain how you influenced a coworker by anchoring in shared goals, conducting a fair side-by-side comparison, presenting data, remaining willing to change your mind, and reaching a concrete collaborative choice.
